answer.rationale: The 18% cost mandate and 14-day deadline force immediate action. The incumbent has delivered stable integration (c1) and multi-year commitments unlock volume pricing (c6). Renegotiating at renewal has recovered margin before (c4). The low-cost vendor's reliability issues (c2 miss rate) disqualify sole-source switching given the 94% line utilization with no buffer—delivery risk would be unacceptable. Adding second source (c3) is valuable for resilience but doesn't solve the cost mandate within 14 days. Negotiating terms leverages the incumbent's proven stability while targeting the required 18% reduction through benchmarking pressure, payment terms improvement, and volume commitment discussions. This preserves the option to add second source later if needed and keeps integration risk low during the tightest operational window.
